description.en: Evidence-informed whole-organism outline reconstruction of Thaumaptilon walcotti, not a modern sea pen or exact specimen replica. Nominal212mm height references ROM complete holotype USNM468028; width50mm follows reported maximum, thickness/color/pose are artistic. Morphological affinity remains disputed: ROM describes historical stem-cnidarian interpretation, Hoyal Cuthill2022 supports Petalonamae. Neither is asserted as settled. Basal anchoring interpretation and pustules-as-zooids uncertain; no feeding tentacles invented.
